text.en: A society needs people free of discrimination and full of reason.

This prose lesson says that a society becomes strong when its people are free from discrimination and have a firm mind, and reason (பகுத்தறிவு) is essential to create such people. It presents Periyar, who worked to bring out the people of Tamil Nadu from the darkness of discrimination through the light of reason.
Periyar saw rationalism and self-respect (சுயமரியாதை) as the two eyes of the people. His ideas urge equality and education.
Terms: பகுத்தறிவு (reason), சுயமரியாதை (self-respect), சமூகம் (society) and சிந்தனை (thought).
